entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • OpenAPI: [Obsolete] on a property leaks `deprecated: true` into the shared component schema #69729
  • OpenAPI: property-level annotations are emitted inside the `oneOf` branch for nullable componentized properties #69727
  • OutputCachePolicyBuilder.With re-evaluates its predicate across policy phases #69720
  • Blazor app returns 404 for ` _framework/dotnet-browser-tools/hot-reload-settings.json` after installing 11.0 RTM #69718
    Backlog
  • Form mapping problems still present in 11.0.0-rc.1: file lists in collection items, root IReadOnlyList<IFormFile>, ']' in dictionary keys #69717
    Backlog

Closed

  • IInvocationBinder throws or returns empty array inconsistently #63084
    12.0-preview1
  • [IIS] [.NET9.0] Application Stopped is fired after Application Started after a pool recycling #69606
  • Output caching: authenticated-user check added to DefaultPolicy.ServeResponseAsync in 10.0.9 silently disables custom policies #69386
    10.0.x
  • validating the service descriptor for PinnedBlockMemoryPoolFactory fails when a custom scoped TimeProvider is registered #67957
